paragraphs: ACI Worldwide sells payments software to banks, merchants and billers, the systems that move money between them. Bill payment is one line of that business, sold as a single platform for a biller and its customers.

Its payments hub is a centralized platform that pulls multiple payment types and channels into one system. The company describes that hub as able to process any payment type originating from any endpoint. A separate high-value product routes wires, Swift and RTGS traffic, with least-cost routing and multi-bank, multi-currency processing. Fraud prevention is sold next to the payment products, using AI to predict and head off fraud.

The company states it has spent 50 years in payments. On the real-time side it says it supports 18 domestic schemes around the world, including FedNow, Zelle and TCH in the United States. Government sits among the industries listed, framed as simplifying and modernizing the payments citizens make.
